data_quality.notes: Gold refresh: Vueling baggage is bundle-driven and date/route-sensitive. All fares include an underseat bag, overhead cabin bags and checked bags depend on bundle or paid add-on, Africa/Middle East routes can have piece restrictions, and airport/gate prices can be much higher than online purchase.

fees.conditions: Every fare includes one underseat cabin bag; large cabin bag access depends on fare, paid add-on, infant, or availability

data_quality.notes: Vueling includes the underseat bag on every fare, but the overhead bag is a separate entitlement and can sell out because overhead capacity is limited.

fees.amount: From EUR 10 to 59 online; higher at airport/gate
fees.conditions: Overhead cabin bag price depends on route, date, bundle, seat choice, and whether bought online or at airport

data_quality.notes: A paid large cabin bag can be placed in the hold for operational reasons; if that happens, Vueling says the paid amount is refunded.

fees.amount: From EUR 10 to 120 by weight tier online
fees.conditions: Checked bags are sold in 15/20/25/30 kg tiers; price changes by route, date, channel, and airport timing
20 kg checked-bag product; price changes by route, season, purchase channel, and timing
25 kg checked-bag product; included with some bundles, otherwise priced by route and timing
30 kg checked-bag product; destination and purchase timing drive the displayed price

data_quality.notes: Vueling sells 15, 20, 25, and 30 kg checked-bag products. Optima/Family include a 25 kg checked bag except for babies, prices vary by destination/date/fare, and some Africa/Middle East routes restrict the number of pieces.

fees.conditions: Excess luggage is charged per kg at check-in when the purchased checked-bag weight is exceeded, up to 32 kg
fees.applies_to: Checked bags above purchased weight allowance

data_quality.notes: The published excess is per kg at the airport above the purchased checked-bag weight, with an absolute 32 kg per-piece ceiling.

fees.amount: Not published as separate flat fee
fees.conditions: Standard checked bags must stay within 158 linear cm; special items use special-luggage handling instead
fees.applies_to: Checked bags above published size limit

data_quality.notes: Vueling publishes size limits and special-luggage handling, but not one universal oversize surcharge for all routes and item types.

fees.conditions: Sports equipment is not included by fare; add it as special luggage and keep it within hold limits
fees.applies_to: Sports equipment, large musical instruments, and special baggage

data_quality.note: Sports equipment and large instruments must be booked under special-baggage rules, properly packed, and within hold limits; bicycles and instruments require a rigid box or case.

fees.conditions: Standard seat selection; free random seat assigned at check-in if not purchased
Front row or extra legroom seats; price varies by route and timing
Flight changes may require a fee plus fare difference; TimeFlex allows changes with fewer restrictions.
Lap-infant adults may bring a 5 kg baby bag plus up to 2 infant items; other car seats are special luggage
fees.applies_to: Infants under 2 and passengers traveling with infant items

data_quality.notes: Infant handling is more generous than the adult Basic fare: stroller/cot/cradle/Group 0+ seat can be free, while other child car seats may require special-luggage handling.

fees.conditions: Ticket refunds not permitted except for flight cancellation or qualifying circumstances
Vueling does not offer an Unaccompanied Minor service; passengers under 16 must travel with an adult
